annotation.title_clean: 国家药监局综合司关于推进“人工智能+药品监管”的文件（国药监综〔2026〕6号）
annotation.title_en: NMPA General Office Document on Advancing "AI + Drug Regulation" (Guoyaojianzong [2026] No. 6)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: National Medical Products Administration (NMPA), General Office
annotation.summary_en: Excerpt of a China NMPA General Office document (No. 6, 11 March 2026) setting goals for integrating AI into drug regulation: by 2030, an "AI + drug regulation" mechanism, compute infrastructure, high-quality datasets, vertical large models and agents applied in review, inspection, testing and services; by 2035, smart, autonomous-controllable drug safety governance.
key_provisions_or_claims: By 2030, initially build an innovation system integrating drug regulation and AI
Develop high-quality datasets, vertical large models and AI agents for regulatory intelligence
Apply AI in review and approval, inspection, testing/monitoring and government services
Improve human-machine collaboration efficiency across full lifecycle regulation
By 2035, form a data-driven, agile, self-controllable, collaborative smart drug safety governance pattern
